changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE user_notifications DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS user_notifications_type_check; ALTER TABLE user_notifications ADD CONSTRAINT user_notifications_type_check CHECK (type IN ( 'APPOINTMENT_REMINDER', 'APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMED', 'APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED', 'APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULED', 'APPOINTMENT_COMPLETED', 'SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION', 'MASS_NOTIFICATION', 'RESCHEDULE_REQUEST_PENDING', 'RESCHEDULE_REQUEST_APPROVED', 'RESCHEDULE_REQUEST_REJECTED', 'REVIEW_RECEIVED'));
